errors.evidence: The x-axis has tick marks and labels for every single year from 2011 to 2024, not every two years.

errors.text_span: Die y-Achse stellt die Lebenszufriedenheit in der Durchschnittszufriedenheit im Bereich von 6,0 bis 7,4 dar,
errors.evidence: The phrase 'Lebenszufriedenheit in der Durchschnittszufriedenheit' is redundant and poorly phrased. The axis label is 'Allgemeine Lebenszufriedenheit (im Durchschnitt)'.

Describing the 'West' line as 'Blau' (blue) is ambiguous, as there are three distinct shades of blue. It should be specified as 'Hellblau' (light blue) to distinguish it from the 'Dunkelblau' (dark blue) 'Gesamtdeutschland' line.
The line for Westdeutschland starts at a value of approximately 7.05 in 2011, not 6.8.

errors.text_span: mit einem Minimum von etwa 6,4 im Jahr 2012
errors.evidence: The minimum for the Westdeutschland line is not 6.4 in 2012. The actual minimum occurs in 2021 at a value of approximately 6.55. The value in 2012 is approximately 7.0.

errors.text_span: einem Maximum von etwa 7,3 im Jahr 2023
errors.evidence: The maximum for the Westdeutschland line is not 7.3 in 2023. The actual maximum occurs in 2019 at a value of approximately 7.2. The value in 2023 is approximately 7.1.
The line for Gesamtdeutschland ends at a value of approximately 7.1 in 2024, which is not 'über 7,2' (over 7.2).

errors.text_span: wobei sie bei 6,6 im Jahr 2012 einen Tiefpunkt erreicht
errors.evidence: The minimum for the Gesamtdeutschland line is not 6.6 in 2012. The actual minimum occurs in 2021 at a value of approximately 6.5. The value in 2012 is approximately 6.95.

errors.text_span: im Jahr 2023 einen Höchstwert von etwa 7,4 erreicht
errors.evidence: The maximum for the Gesamtdeutschland line is not 7.4 in 2023. The actual maximum occurs in 2019 at a value of approximately 7.15. The value in 2023 is approximately 7.0.
The line for Ostdeutschland is not yellow; it is a very light blue or grey-blue.

errors.text_span: und sich im Jahr 2013 und 2014 auf etwa 6,5 reduziert
errors.evidence: The line for Ostdeutschland does not drop to 6.5 in 2013 and 2014. In those years, the value is approximately 6.75 and 6.7, respectively. The lowest point for this line is in 2021 at about 6.4.
The description completely omits the presence of vertical error bars on each data point, which is a significant visual feature of the chart.
